label: GitHub
description: Runs one GitHub operation: issues (create, get, list, comment, edit labels, close), pull requests (open, wait for checks, run failed checks again, merge, close), the latest release, editing files or reverting a commit on a new branch, and running or waiting for a workflow. The result becomes the task output.

inputs.name: repository
inputs.label: Repository
inputs.description: owner/name; the calling repository when empty

inputs.name: issue
inputs.label: Issue number
inputs.description: For every operation on one issue

inputs.name: title
inputs.label: Title
inputs.description: Issue or pull request title, for create-issue and create-pull-request

inputs.name: body
inputs.label: Body
inputs.description: Markdown text of the issue, comment or pull request

inputs.name: labels
inputs.label: Labels
inputs.description: Comma-separated labels to set, add or filter by

inputs.name: remove_labels
inputs.label: Labels to remove
inputs.description: Comma-separated, for edit-labels

inputs.name: state
inputs.label: State
inputs.description: For list-issues

inputs.name: limit
inputs.label: Limit
inputs.description: Most issues list-issues returns, from 1 to 100

inputs.name: ref
inputs.label: Branch
inputs.description: Branch that edit-files and revert-commit create and create-pull-request opens from, or the ref run-workflow runs on

inputs.name: base
inputs.label: Base branch
inputs.description: Branch the new branch starts from and pull requests target; the default branch when empty

inputs.name: path
inputs.label: Files
inputs.description: Glob of the files edit-files changes, such as .github/workflows/*.yml

inputs.name: find
inputs.label: Find
inputs.description: Extended regular expression edit-files replaces

inputs.name: replace
inputs.label: Replace with
inputs.description: Replacement for find; \1 to \9 insert its groups

inputs.name: message
inputs.label: Commit message
inputs.description: For edit-files and revert-commit

inputs.name: commit
inputs.label: Commit
inputs.description: SHA that revert-commit reverts or wait-workflow waits for

inputs.name: pull_request
inputs.label: Pull request number
inputs.description: For the pull request operations

inputs.name: merge_method
inputs.label: Merge method
inputs.description: For merge-pull-request

inputs.name: workflow
inputs.label: Workflow
inputs.description: Workflow file name, for run-workflow and wait-workflow

inputs.name: workflow_inputs
inputs.label: Workflow inputs
inputs.description: JSON object of strings run-workflow dispatches the workflow with

inputs.name: timeout_minutes
inputs.label: Timeout (minutes)
inputs.description: Longest a waiting operation waits, from 1 to 45

inputs.name: app_client_id
inputs.label: GitHub App client id
inputs.description: A GitHub App installed on the repository; its token is used when set

secrets.name: token
secrets.description: Token for operations that change something, such as the caller's GITHUB_TOKEN with issues: write

secrets.name: app_private_key
secrets.description: Private key of the GitHub App named by app_client_id

outputs.name: output
outputs.description: The whole task output as compact JSON, empty when larger than 32 KiB
